voice_lines: December has the biggest year end discounts. From January, prices often go up.
The catch: a car bought in December looks a year older on paper within weeks, which matters at resale.
Whenever you buy, check the manufacturing month on the VIN plate, avoid very old stock, and get the discount in writing.
Keeping it seven years or more? Take the December deal. Selling in two or three? Think about January. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
December or January, when should you buy your car? 🗓️

December: the biggest year-end discounts. January: prices often go up.

The catch: a December car is a year older on paper within weeks, which shows at resale.

Whenever you buy:
• Check the manufacturing month on the VIN plate
• Avoid stock that's many months old
• Get the discount in writing

Keeping it 7+ years? Take the December deal. Selling in 2-3? January may suit you.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
